# Split-flap

Departure-board precision with a mechanical editorial character.

## Use

Use for status summaries, scheduled learning, and progress milestones.

## Essential traits

- Segmented mechanical headings
- Matte board surfaces
- Legible state labels

## Typography

System monospace with uppercase short labels; sentence-case body.

## Layout and surfaces

Segmented labels, crisp alignment, and clear numeric hierarchy. Dark mechanical panels, fine separators, optional short label flip.

## Palette

- background: #121514
- surface: #202522
- text: #f4f5e9
- muted: #c0c5b7
- accent: #ebd8a8
- border: #687263

## Copy-ready prompt

```text
Apply Split-flap to [DELIVERABLE] for [AUDIENCE]. Purpose: [GOAL]. Preserve all supplied content, existing visuals, and required brand constraints. System monospace with uppercase short labels; sentence-case body. Segmented labels, crisp alignment, and clear numeric hierarchy. Dark mechanical panels, fine separators, optional short label flip. Palette: background #121514, surface #202522, text #f4f5e9, muted #c0c5b7, accent #ebd8a8, border #687263. Essential traits: Segmented mechanical headings; Matte board surfaces; Legible state labels. Avoid: Continuous flipping; All-caps paragraphs; Animations that hide current values. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
